description: Reviewed boundary, rich-inline, shared complex-walker, leading-ZWSP, exclamation-break, figure-space glue, pair-table gap, CJK closing-bracket, Safari line-edge kerning, WebKit engine routing, segment-break removal, and Safari next-line and tab-stop fixes.
